title: 1721 Prairie, the Dexter house, rebuilt to its 1891 plate
items: The Wirt Dexter house at 1721 Prairie Avenue now stands as Arthur Little's front of 1889, read off the Inland Architect plate of 1891: three pale storeys under a deep cornice and a flat roof, its entrance porch on two columns set back in a recess at the north end, its roof railed as a balcony, and the rest of the front stepping forward with two bows rising through two storeys and a tall stack beside the porch. The long two-storey wing behind it runs back toward the alley as the 1911 map draws it.
